project_type: pnpm monorepo: Express 5 + Prisma 7 (Postgres) API in apps/api, React 19 + Vite 8 + React Router 7 web in apps/web. Zod 4 for validation on both sides. No shared package between api and web (FormSchema types are hand-duplicated across the two by established convention).
build_system: pnpm workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml globs apps/*, packages/*). Root scripts in package.json: build:api, build:web, typecheck. API tsconfig has strict:true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes:true, verbatimModuleSyntax:true, module nodenext — so .js extensions are required on relative imports and optional fields MUST be added via conditional-spread (never `key: undefined`). Web tsconfig.json is a SOLUTION file (references tsconfig.app.json + tsconfig.node.json) so web typecheck uses `tsc -b`.
test_framework: apps/web already has vitest@^3.2.4 (`test`: `vitest run`). apps/api has NO test runner (stub `echo ... exit 1`) — FEAT-001 adds vitest@^3.2.4 + apps/api/vitest.config.ts as its first steps. Tests are pure-function unit tests only (token sign/verify, Zod parse, resolveTheme, Chips); DB/HTTP integration is a MANUAL checklist (design §2.11), not automated.
build_command: API typecheck: `cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit`. Web typecheck: `cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit`. Web full build: `cd apps/web && pnpm build` (runs `tsc -b && vite build`).
test_command: API: `cd apps/api && pnpm test` (after FEAT-001). Web: `cd apps/web && pnpm test`.
verification_instructions: After each feature: API typecheck exits 0; web typecheck exits 0; relevant unit tests pass. Final: both typechecks exit 0, both `pnpm test` pass, `cd apps/web && pnpm build` succeeds. Baselines were confirmed green before planning (API tsc 0, web tsc -b 0). Run feasible items of design §2.11 manual checklist for Feature 2.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. No Prisma migration is created (theme + editing settings live in the existing schema JSON; editedAt in the existing FormResponse.metadata JSON; edit token is stateless HMAC). Do NOT run prisma migrate.
environment_constraints: No push, no PR — commit locally only on the current branch. Do NOT add a Prisma migration. Relative imports in apps/api require .js extensions (verbatimModuleSyntax + nodenext). exactOptionalPropertyTypes:true means optional object properties must use conditional-spread, not `{ key: undefined }`.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md / .kiro/steering present in the repo. Follow existing code conventions in the touched files. Keep behavior of un-themed/editing-disabled forms byte-identical (verified fallbacks).
key_patterns: Settings live in FormSchema.settings inside the form `schema` JSON column. getFormSchema() copies optional fields through with conditional-spread and gives concrete defaults only where downstream code needs them. updateFormSettings merges via per-field conditional spread. getPublicForm destructures ONLY responseNotification + sendConfirmationEmail out of publicSettings — any new settings field rides through automatically; do NOT add theme/responseEditing to that omit-list. app.ts error handler is a `switch(error.name)` with a 500 default; PUBLIC_FORM_NOT_FOUND(404), RESPONSE_NOT_FOUND(404), INVALID_RESPONSE(400), FORM_CLOSED(410) already have cases; new error names MUST get explicit cases or they become 500. csrf.ts exempts any path containing `/public/`. env.ts `optional(key, fallback)` takes exactly two args. cloudinary.ts uses node:crypto. Service functions throw Errors with a `.name` the error handler switches on.
